content_sections.heading: How to Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to apply for JNU Advocate Recruitment 2026 through offline mode should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before applying. Download the application form from the official website: www.jnu.ac.in. Fill the application form carefully with correct information. Attach self-attested copies of required documents such as photograph, signature, ID proof, and certificates. Check all details carefully before submission. Send the completed application form to the address mentioned in the notification through Speed Post / Registered Post or as instructed. Ensure the application reaches before the last date: 29-08-2026. Keep a photocopy of the submitted application form for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the JNU Advocate/Law Firm recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to receive applications for the JNU Advocate/Law Firm recruitment is 29 August 2026. Ensure your application reaches the designated address before this date.

faq.question: Q2. What is the mode of application for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The application mode for the JNU Advocate/Law Firm recruitment is offline. Candidates need to download the application form, fill it, and send it via post.

faq.question: Q3. What are the essential qualifications for the Advocate/Law Firm post?
faq.answer: Candidates must hold a Bachelor's degree in Law from a recognized university, be registered with the Bar Council, and possess at least 5 years of professional experience in handling cases related to educational institutes, universities, or government departments.

faq.question: Q4. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q5. What is the selection process for the JNU Advocate/Law Firm posts?
faq.answer: The selection process for the JNU Advocate/Law Firm posts involves shortlisting of eligible candidates followed by an interaction session.

faq.question: Q6. What is the job type for this JNU recruitment?
faq.answer: The job type for the Advocate/Law Firm posts at Jawaharlal Nehru University is contractual.

faq.question: Q7. Where can I download the application form?
faq.answer: The application form can be downloaded from the official website of Jawaharlal Nehru University, which is www.jnu.ac.in.

faq.question: Q8. What is the advertisement number for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The advertisement number for this recruitment is Empanelment/Legal/JNU/.

faq.question: Q9. Does JNU provide any salary for the Advocate/Law Firm position?
faq.answer: Salary details are not explicitly mentioned in the provided data. Candidates are advised to refer to the official notification for specific salary information.

faq.answer: There is one vacancy available for the Advocate/Law Firm post in this recruitment drive.
